project.name: Andromeda
project.purpose: CLI control plane that replaces Drupal Aegir / BOA for Backdrop CMS. Manages platforms and sites: create, backup, restore, clone, migrate, upgrade, disable, delete. No Aegir frontend.
goals: Migrate leftover Drupal 7 / BOA sites onto Backdrop CMS
Replicate Aegir verbs without a PHP hosting UI
Drive everything with POSIX sh + Backdrop Bee (not Drush)
Reuse POSIX tools: crdir, newfeature, Apache vhosts, git
Run on a modest VPS or a workstation without a control panel
non_goals: Nginx as the default web server (Apache is the default stack)
Rootless Podman as the default runtime (native stack is faster and already running)

environment.web_server: Apache 2 (prefork or event + php module or php-fpm via existing Devuan packages)
environment.php: PHP 8.1+ from Devuan/backports as available; Bee-compatible

dns.devel: dnsmasq or /etc/hosts on the devel host: *.devel → 192.168.1.120 (LAN) and 10.8.0.1 (WireGuard)
dns.test_live: public DNS + Cloudflare on the VPS
dns.legacy_wildcards_not_used: *.star was in the Artix draft; devel host already uses <product>.devel

environment.firewall: CSF on top of iptables. SSH is not world-open: allow 22 only from WireGuard 10.8.0.0/24 and LAN 192.168.1.0/24. UDP 51820 open for WG. HTTP 80 on devel; 80+443 on test/live. Enable with andromeda-install.sh -F (TESTING=1 first).
environment.ide: Theia optional; not required for CLI

layout_decision.chosen: Existing devel host Composer-style Backdrop tree under /srv/platforms
layout_decision.rejected: Artix draft /srv/www/<uri> → symlink-to-platform (breaks Bee --root/--site and the ecom/torg tutorials already written)
reason: sites.php maps hostnames; one Apache DocumentRoot per environment
No custom settings.php path overrides, no Nginx aliases

environment_checkouts.rule: Never run devel/test/live out of one working copy

torg.status: tutorial file is currently a copy of ecom; treat as second platform when products are named

crdir.role: mkdir + chown deploy:www-data + mode 0770 + optional setgid
crdir.rule: parents mkdir -p only; named dirs get ownership

newfeature.role: provision a Git worktree preview from a site root

cli.name: andromeda
cli.language: POSIX sh (same as crdir/newfeature). No Python runtime required on the devel host.

verbs.platform-add: clone a Backdrop tree into /srv/platforms/<name>, run crdir for known product dirs
verbs.platform-upgrade: git pull + bee updb per product (after backup)
verbs.site-add: create DB user, settings.local.php, crdir files/config, bee install, Apache ServerAlias if needed
verbs.site-backup: bee db-export + tar files + tar private + copy config/active → /srv/andromeda/backups/...
verbs.site-restore: inverse of backup onto a named checkout
verbs.site-clone: backup source + site-add dest + restore files/db + rewrite trusted_host_patterns
verbs.site-migrate: clone across platform or env checkouts
verbs.site-disable: Apache deny + settings flag; keep DB
verbs.site-delete: require --yes; drop DB, remove site files, leave platform
verbs.ssl: no-op on the devel host HTTP devel; on VPS defer to Cloudflare Flexible vs Full (strict) as in ecom tutorial

conventions.never_sudo_the_wrapper: script calls sudo only for mkdir/chown/chmod/a2ensite like crdir

bootstrap_script.name: andromeda-install.sh
bootstrap_script.purpose: Idempotent Devuan setup. Prepares packages, dirs, Bee, conf. Does not wipe existing /srv/platforms/ecom.
key_actions: apt-get update && install: apache2, php, php-mysql, php-xml, php-gd, php-mbstring, php-curl, php-zip, mariadb-server, git, certbot (VPS only), dnsmasq (devel host only)
MariaDB bind 127.0.0.1; unix_socket for root; per-site users later
PHP: memory_limit 256M, upload/post 64M, opcache on; keep conservative defaults
Install Bee from git to /usr/local/bin/bee if missing
Do not recreate /srv/platforms if it already holds ecom
Apache: do not install a catch-all *.star vhost; keep per-platform env vhosts
sysvinit: /etc/init.d/apache2 and /etc/init.d/mysql only; no openrc, no systemd

dev_pod_script.name: andromeda-pod.sh
dev_pod_script.reason: devel host already runs Apache + PHP + MariaDB on the metal. A Podman pod (nginx + php-fpm + mariadb) duplicates RAM and fights the existing DocumentRoot layout. Revisit only if a laptop without Devuan Apache needs an isolated demo.

apache_config_highlights.pattern: one VirtualHost per platform+env, ServerName + ServerAlias for each product hostname
apache_config_highlights.directory: AllowOverride All, FollowSymLinks, Require all granted on web/

security.preprocess_css_js: off on devel, on on live

mysql.note: MariaDB data lives on RAID1 SSD; do not copy Artix docker volume defaults

apache_php.max_children: keep modest; 8 cores share Gitea + MariaDB + Bee

steps: bee/drush db-export on the old tree
copy to the devel host over WireGuard (user@10.8.0.1)
site-add into an existing platform product folder
rewrite settings.php paths; never keep the old $database line
leave the BOA tree running until the .devel hostname looks right

implementation_order: 1. Freeze this file as the contract
2. andromeda-install.sh (apt, dirs, Bee, ~/.andromeda.conf) — no-op if already present
3. andromeda CLI skeleton: list, backup (wraps bee db-export + tar)
4. site-add wrapping crdir + bee install + settings.local.php template
6. platform-upgrade (git + updb + config-import) with mandatory backup first
7. Only then consider disable/delete and VPS test/live helpers
